capabilities: Estimate recall probability per note with an Ebbinghaus decay model
Open contributing notes from clickable status cards
Estimate per-note review time from a complexity value
Reinforce a note's stability through a review action
disambiguation: Not a mind-map or graph view of note links; it estimates memory retention and tracks review status.
extras: README presents the feature set as the current MVP and gives no usage instructions or screenshots; a live settings example shows how the complexity value changes the review-time estimate.
problem: Obsidian shows what you have written but not which notes you are forgetting or when they need review, so memory health across a vault stays invisible.
summary: Dashboard that estimates each note's recall probability with an Ebbinghaus decay model and offers a review action to reinforce it.
